component.name: NautiBoy
component.summary: Linux controller for Corsair NAUTILUS RS LCD displays

description.p: NautiBoy is an open-source Linux controller for Corsair NAUTILUS RS LCD displays.
NautiBoy is an unofficial community project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Corsair.
Adds hardware-validated local GIF playback, bounded deadline scheduling, KDE tray operation, per-user autostart, single-instance protection, and experimental GIPHY development search.
